name: Null-Scattering Transmittance Sampling
definition: A method to sample scattering events along a ray segment using a majorant density (sigma_maj) that bounds the actual density, allowing for null events when the sampled density exceeds the physical density.
summary: Null-Scattering Transmittance Sampling is an unbiased volumetric path tracing technique that efficiently handles sparse media by using a constant majorant extinction coefficient and null events to sample interaction points.
